messages:
morgan: Heads up team — found a flow where PII (SSN/email) can end up attached to embeddings in the debug capture store.
lee: Ack. Repro locally?
sara: Example pls (no real data) so we can design redaction.
morgan: Repro: client sends prompt with SSN; capture path sets persist_original=true and we call embed(text) then save {orig, emb}. If console.inspect is on the blob is saved unredacted.
vikram: Current scrub only covers full-text logs, not the embeddings index. The index is searchable & used for rerank.
lee: Is this limited to debug/canary?
morgan: Mostly debug captures + a handful of canary tenants where inspect was enabled.
sara: We should not keep raw text next to embeddings by default. Options: pre-embed redaction or store only hashed/synthetic provenance.
vikram: Pre-embed redaction alters semantics; hashing loses recoverability for replay. Need to balance safety vs debugability.
lee: Could we encrypt the original with tenant KMS and surface a gated "request unredacted" flow?
morgan: Works but slows console "view original"; also needs ACL + audit flow.
sara: UX compromise: show redacted preview in console with redaction confidence, and add a button that requests an audited decrypt (ticket + audit log).
devex: @morgan paste the capture config so we can propose toggles.
morgan: Snippet:
```json
{"capture": {"inspect_enabled": true, "persist_original": true, "persist_embedding": true}, "headers": {"X-Debug-Inspect": "true"}}
```
lee: Suggest default persist_original=false and a new field redaction_level: "none|partial|full".
vikram: Implementation: run lightweight regex scrub pre-embed as fallback; ML PII model behind feature flag. Pre-embed hook costs ~5-20ms on debug path.
sara: Also storage/egress costs increase if we keep originals — good ops argument for default off.
morgan: Proposed immediate steps: 1) default persist_original=false, 2) pre-embed redaction for any persist_embedding path, 3) console: redaction confidence + "Request unredacted (audit)" button.
lee: Add SRE canary + quota limits for a gradual rollout.
vikram: Backend tasks: pre-embed hook + regex scrub, feature-flag ML scrub, sampling rule (0.1%) for original persistence during canary.
morgan: I'll draft a short RFC and link console mocks.
sara: I'll design the console flows and audit ticket UX.
devex: Ping compliance/legal once RFC exists.
oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall runbook so oncall knows original captures are disabled by default and how to request an audit unwrap.
morgan: Action owners: RFC (morgan), console mock (sara), SRE canary + quotas (lee), pre-embed hook + scrub (vikram), compliance ping (morgan).
sara: +1 :thumbsup:
lee: +1
vikram: Opening PR for regex scrub + hook, will tag reviewers.
morgan: Keeping thread for updates, will post RFC link soon.
